scenarios.name: Bull: AI Cloud Acceleration & Domestic Take-Rate Rebound
assumptions: Cloud Intelligence AI product revenue compounds at >100% CAGR, driving segment EBITA margins toward 15% as Qwen open-source model enterprise subscriptions surge.
Taobao/Tmall customer management revenue (CMR) growth accelerates past GMV growth as the universal 0.6% software service fee and Quanzhantui ad engine achieve full merchant penetration.
AIDC international commerce achieves segment-level adjusted EBITA breakeven as AliExpress Choice unit fulfillment costs drop via Cainiao global sorting hubs.
Disciplined share repurchases of $12B+ annually retire ~5% of outstanding ADS count each year, providing strong mechanical EPS accretion.

scenarios.name: Base: Steady Core Stabilization & Disciplined Capital Return
assumptions: Taobao/Tmall GMV expands at low-single digits (3-4% YoY), defending market share against Pinduoduo and Douyin in core apparel and FMCG categories.
Cloud Intelligence delivers mid-teens revenue growth (14-16% YoY) with public cloud margins stabilizing around 10-12% adjusted EBITA.
AIDC international retail losses narrow sustainably to under -$1.0B annually, with AliExpress Choice and Trendyol expanding high-retention consumer cohorts.
Free cash flow conversion remains resilient at >$16B annually, funding $12B in ADS buybacks alongside regular annual dividend distributions (~2.2% yield).

scenarios.name: Bear: Macro Thrift & Cross-Border De Minimis Tariff Drag
assumptions: Domestic consumption deflation persists, forcing aggressive merchant subsidies and defensive price-matching that dilute CMR take rates.
US and EU eliminate Section 321 de minimis tax exemptions on low-value parcels, reducing AliExpress cross-border parcel volumes and delaying AIDC breakeven.
Tightening of US semiconductor export controls constrains high-end GPU cluster expansions for Cloud Intelligence, slowing enterprise GenAI adoption.
Fierce cloud infrastructure price competition from state-backed telecom operators and Tencent compresses cloud gross margins below 8%.
